patterns: Most asked: Kalidasa (and Bharavi) named in the Aihole inscription of Pulakesin II, by Ravikirti - recurring across UPSC/UPPSC.
Single-fact recall: capital Vatapi, greatest ruler Pulakesin II, defeated Harsha (Narmada), Dakshinapatheshwara title (match with Harsha's Sakalottarapathanatha, Kushana Devaputra).
APPSC tilt: Andhra inscriptions of Pulakesin II (Mangalagiri = Mangalapura via Marturu/Kopparam), Vengi conquest -> Eastern Chalukyas.
Trap: Chalukyas did not rule North India; last ruler Kirtivarman II overthrown by Dantidurga.
App adds dense statement/match items on regency, Lohnara, Ma Twan-lin, Guntur plates - deeper than PYQs but mostly sound.
